charter:
# Charter — T0 Model and contracts (retrospective, 2026-11-26)

- **Project:** T0 'Model and contracts', track v2, ADM phase G, plateau capability, tranche 0, project `01a1d039-0d32-7734-98da-fb7f1e2386c7`, plan `docs/SPEC_V2.md#12` (draft). The row records `status: closed`, `meta.measured_status: built`, `meta.viability: rework`, `meta.expected_outputs: [project-brief, evidence]`, `meta.closure_outputs: [closure-review]`, `meta.tranche: 0`, `meta.track: v2`, `meta.adm_phase: G` and `meta.close_reason: the retrospective rework of tranche 0 (#526)`. It was reopened at 2026-11-21T20:59:32Z for 'the merged audit finds open P0 v1-w1a-2 after the retrospective closure; rework (#526)' under decision `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`.
- **Mandate:** install the organisation spine and its contracts — industry → ordered departments → `job_catalogue`, the immutable `job_release`, the tenant-scoped `job_binding`; the decision-ladder types; and the internal `Executor` contract with two live kinds behind one trait and an extensible `executor_kind`. The gate is a job created in the conveyor, a release published, a binding pinning its hash, a run on a retired binding refused `409 job_binding_stale`, no concept in two stores, and a test-only third executor kind registered without editing the run path (SPEC_V2 §12).
- **Scope:** the model and its invariants (SPEC_V2 §3 P1–P11, §4.1–§4.6, §10.1, §10.3, §10.4) and the action contracts the registry serves, pinned by `served-spec.lock.json` (version 1, 650 operations). The seven Phase A–D artefacts, the live Statement of Architecture Work `01a1ff45-b2ce-7276-8a88-cf3d744e7976`, the board-approved delivery contract `01a1ff47-1159-707b-a737-582f894cc956`, the approved scope baseline `01a1ff47-5043-73f7-b18d-2fc03832c96a` and the compliant review `01a1ff48-20c6-77d2-b0d1-5fd0ca2b7d9c` are the record this pack re-issues. Execution behaviour is T2, the plan spine T1 and the tool platform T13.
- **Provenance and residual:** T0 first closed on 2026-11-14; its original charter, Statement of Architecture Work, delivery contract, Phase-G review and closure review were never authored. The contemporaneous record is the evidence document `01a1e688-678d-76fd-8ae7-6ca2712b64c2` and the git history. The lifecycle was reconstituted on 2026-11-21 under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`, and this pack records the rework rather than claiming contemporaneous intent.
- **Date:** this charter is retrospective and authored on 2026-11-26; it records the lifecycle and does not authorise new work.

soaw.title: Statement of Architecture Work — T0 Model and contracts (retrospective, 2026-11-26)

body.assignment: Rework T0 by the reconstituted TOGAF/MSP lifecycle: author the charter, this Statement of Architecture Work, the seven mandatory Phase A–D artefacts, the delivery contract, the WBS deliverable and the Phase-G review, and publish the project-brief and evidence outputs that SPEC_V2 §12's model and contracts owe. The work is retrospective, dated 2026-11-26, and records the 2026-11-25 acceptance state without claiming that it cleared.
body.scope: The model and its invariants (SPEC_V2 §3 P1–P11, §4.1–§4.6, §10.1, §10.3, §10.4): the organisation spine — industry, ordered departments, job_catalogue, the immutable job_release and the tenant-scoped job_binding; the decision-ladder types; and the internal Executor contract. The action contracts are those the registry serves and served-spec.lock.json pins (version 1, 650 operations). Out of scope: execution behaviour (T2), the plan spine (T1), the tool platform (T13), and any external executor, which stays an explicit non-goal until the four §4.5 conditions hold.
body.responsibilities: The programme architect (conveyor-e2e) authors the pack under the standing delegation 01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14; the Architecture Board (conveyor-architecture-board) reviews the A–D set; conveyor-approver records the Phase-G review. The live Statement of Architecture Work 01a1ff45-b2ce-7276-8a88-cf3d744e7976 is approved by 01a1ff45-c6f7-7a7d-ab9f-0c9c8293147e, and the delivery contract 01a1ff47-1159-707b-a737-582f894cc956 by 01a1ff47-24cb-7ffb-87a0-3097d55adb64; both are approved by 01a1e8a7-8b23-76a9-9114-aafb95f7a545, distinct from the requester 01a1e607-17d9-77d3-98d3-a43a87c4633d.
body.acceptance_criteria: SPEC_V2 §12's T0 gate in six clauses: a job is created in the conveyor; a release is published; a binding pins its hash; a run on a retired binding refuses 409 job_binding_stale before any model call; no concept has two stores; and a test-only third executor kind registers without editing the run path (crates/domain/src/executor.rs, crates/actions/src/organisation.rs, crates/actions/tests/executor_runtime.rs). The A–D set is approved. The acceptance instrument is acceptance/programme/T0.toml. The rework note records verify-project green with 11 checks and 0 failures at d7293f96 on 2026-11-21; docs/evidence/rework/T0.json, generated 2026-11-25T10:37:53Z at 37f99108, is red on T0-artefact-standard, T0-rework, the gate aggregate and closed-on-red, so this statement records the terms and does not certify them.
body.contract: This statement sits on the approved scope baseline 01a1ff47-5043-73f7-b18d-2fc03832c96a (approved by 01a1e8a7-8b23-76a9-9114-aafb95f7a545, taken by 01a1e607-17d9-77d3-98d3-a43a87c4633d) and is complemented by the delivery contract 01a1ff47-1159-707b-a737-582f894cc956; the Phase-G review is 01a1ff48-20c6-77d2-b0d1-5fd0ca2b7d9c at level compliant. The live statement it records is 01a1ff45-b2ce-7276-8a88-cf3d744e7976. It is a retrospective instrument under the delegation 01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14 and is dated 2026-11-26.

The catalog carries eight rows. Industry and department hold the organisation spine; job_catalogue holds the position; job_release holds the immutable compiled release; job_binding joins the position, the release and the executor for one tenant. Each row names its owner system and key fields so no entity is claimed by a second store.

Each row is read from the spec's data-model table or the named source file, and a concept that belongs to T1, T2 or T13 is not claimed here.

# Project brief — T0 Model and contracts (retrospective, 2026-11-26)

## Outcome

T0 installs the conveyor's organisation spine and its contracts: industry → ordered departments → job_catalogue, the immutable job_release, and the tenant-scoped job_binding; the decision-ladder types; and the internal Executor contract with two live kinds behind one trait and an extensible executor_kind. The slice's gate is that a job is created in the conveyor, a release is published, a binding pins its hash, a run on a retired binding refuses 409 job_binding_stale before any model call, no concept has two stores, and a test-only third executor kind registers without editing the run path. The row records status closed, measured status built and viability rework, and is re-closed through the one gate on the record this pack re-issues.

## Boundary

Out of scope: execution behaviour, which arrives with T2; the plan spine, which is T1; and the tool platform, which is T13. No external executor is in scope: SPEC_V2 §4.5 makes one an explicit non-goal until a generic work-packet ingress returns verifiable per-step evidence, governance sits at the boundary, owners and roadmaps are separate, and it beats the internal agent on the conveyor's own benchmark. Customer care is the agent platform's product, not conveyor work (D48). The agent platform is a front end over MCP, never a runtime for conveyor jobs.

## Reuse sources

The content source is docs/SPEC_V2.md §3 (P1–P11), §4.1–§4.6, §10.1, §10.3 and §10.4. The action contracts are served-spec.lock.json, version 1 with 650 operations, written and checked through crates/actions/src/lock.rs. The code carriers are crates/domain/src/executor.rs (the Executor trait, the open ExecutorKind slug and the registry), crates/actions/src/organisation.rs (the organisation actions and the 409 job_binding_stale refusal) and crates/actions/tests/executor_runtime.rs (including a_third_kind_registers_without_editing_the_run_loop). The seven approved A–D rows and their documents dated 2026-11-22 are re-versioned, not replaced.

## Inception units

This retrospective is the inception record. It carries the charter, the Statement of Architecture Work (live record 01a1ff45-b2ce-7276-8a88-cf3d744e7976), the seven A–D artefacts (Stakeholder Map 01a20235-b523-700a-93e5-cfe7331dd2fe, Driver/Goal/Objective Catalog 01a2020c-f6bc-7f62-917e-9d43f1873309, Requirements Catalog 01a20211-c0b6-7ec0-8104-90a52f26d58d, Solution Concept Diagram 01a2021b-0621-701c-bc44-cc7f3b80e429, Business Capability Map 01a2023d-3076-76e9-9d03-4e96cd16fbea, Data Entity/Data Component Catalog 01a20243-b153-728c-b4b8-5cb0f270a3dd and Technology Standards Catalog 01a20247-822f-74be-b5a6-0e0e160eb317), the delivery contract 01a1ff47-1159-707b-a737-582f894cc956 and one WBS deliverable whose WSJF inputs are 8, 8, 8 and 5.

## Dependencies

Typed dependencies from SPEC_V2 §12: T1 follows T0, T2 follows T1 and T3 follows T2; T4 follows T3; T9 and T10 run after T1 and T3; T13 follows T2. Within the slice, a job_binding depends on an immutable job_release, a card depends on a binding, and a run depends on the binding's pin and the resolved release. Governance dependencies are the compliant review 01a1ff48-20c6-77d2-b0d1-5fd0ca2b7d9c, the approved baseline 01a1ff47-5043-73f7-b18d-2fc03832c96a and the standing delegation 01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14.

## Acceptance

SPEC_V2 §12's T0 gate in six clauses: a job created, a release published, a binding pinning its hash, a retired binding refusing 409 job_binding_stale, no concept in two stores, and a test-only third executor kind without an edit to the run path; the A–D set approved. The instrument is acceptance/programme/T0.toml. The rework note records scripts/verify-project.py green with 11 checks and 0 failures at d7293f96 on 2026-11-21; docs/evidence/rework/T0.json, generated 2026-11-25T10:37:53Z at 37f99108, is red on six mandatory packages, so the re-closure is claimed through the one gate only when a regenerated record passes.

## Capabilities

Seven capabilities are declared. Organisation catalogue authors industries, departments and positions. Release compilation produces an immutable release with a content hash and frozen snapshot. Binding and pinning joins a position to one release for one tenant and refuses a stale pin. Executor selection serves procedure and internal_agent behind one trait and registers a third kind without editing the run path. The action contract registry serves one declaration as HTTP, MCP, OpenAPI and a client and pins the surface. Ownership enforcement keeps one system of record per fact. Tenant configuration keeps policy values in versioned rows. Each is declared with a named carrier and none is claimed beyond what the record shows.

## Plan

The retrospective proceeds in the rework runner's order: author the charter and the Statement of Architecture Work, re-version the seven A–D artefacts by their exact existing titles with entries and links, record the delivery contract and the one WBS deliverable, record the Phase-G review at compliant, publish this brief and the evidence output, then record the closure review and the closure through the one gate. It keeps two residuals on the record: the 2026-11-25 acceptance record is red on six packages, and the original lifecycle records were never authored, leaving the evidence document and the git history as the contemporaneous record.
